desc:
🎮 Official Roblox adaptation of FART TOGETHER! 🎮

💨 FART TOGETHER! is a chaotic physics-based co-op parkour game where hippos steer the SAME boat using nothing but fart power!

🦛 Play solo or jump on board with up to 4 players!

🎯 Aim your direction, time your blast, control your gas.
🚤 Everyone pushes the same boat, so if one hippo farts the wrong way, the whole crew goes off course!
🌊 Dodge obstacles, survive tricky courses and reach the finish line together.

🤝 The secret isn't farting harder. It's farting TOGETHER at the right time! 💨

⚠️ WARNING: This game may test your friendships.

Original game by GamesMrkt.
Roblox version developed by FXFX Studio in partnership with the original team.
